core: Original GL-weighted recurrence, Hurst mapping, Gaussian innovations and reflected sector Laplacian unchanged
forecast: Condition on observed returns, anchor last price, compute exact conditional lognormal mean
outer_default: Last 30 percent; previous windows are exploratory because already inspected
inner_validation: Final 40 percent of development, expanding origins every 21 observations; at least three complete origins
forecast_blend: Constrained least squares coefficient in [0,1] between memory mean and log-drift baseline, shared across sectors, selected per horizon on internal validation only
selection_score: Mean squared price error divided by origin price squared; equal asset weighting
overlapping_targets: 21-session targets overlap; no iid confidence tests
claim_boundary: If selected blend weight is zero, report it explicitly as baseline selection, not predictive memory evidence
